# Vendored spreadsheet parser

This directory contains the official SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 standalone browser build used for local XLSX, XLSM, XLSB and XLS parsing.

- Distribution: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- SHA-256: `CC015130AA8521E7F088F88898EBA949CCDCBFB38DF0BD129B44B7273C3A6F41`
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/

The build is used only as a parser/writer. VBA, external links and embedded code are never executed. Review the upstream license and release notes before using the application in a controlled production environment.
